summary.tagline: Rugged sea cliffs, flower-dotted heathland, and vital bird colonies along the Ynys Môn coast.

travel.headline: Monitor Seabird Seasons and Local Parking Rules
travel.reservation: While entry to the National Landscape is generally open, specific managed areas like South Stack apply parking charges year-round. There is strictly no overnight parking or camping allowed within the reserve boundaries; visitors should verify seasonal visitor center hours directly with the RSPB.

days.title: Coastal Cliffs and Seabird Colonies

stops.name: South Stack
stops.detail: Observe breeding Guillemots, Razorbills, and Puffins from the rugged sea cliffs and visit Ellin's Tower for views over the Irish Sea.

days.driving: Allow 15-30 minutes for local coastal roads; conditions vary with weather.
days.note: Spring is the primary window for viewing nesting seabird colonies.

intel.title: South Stack Facilities
intel.text: The Visitor Centre has a tarmac surface while other lots use compacted stone. Blue Badge spaces are available at Ellin's Tower, but there are no height restrictions or formal drop-off points.

intel.title: Connectivity Gaps
intel.text: Evidence does not specify cellular coverage levels along the cliffs. Visitors should download maps before departing Holyhead.

intel.title: Supply Points
intel.text: Fuel and supplies are not documented within the reserve. Ensure vehicles are fueled in nearby gateway towns before heading to the coastal periphery.

intel.title: Seasonal Birding
intel.text: Puffins and Razorbills are present in spring, while the rare Chough can be spotted year-round. Plan visits during daylight as there is no site lighting.

intel.title: Path Conditions
intel.text: A level path provides access to the viewpoint outside Ellin's Tower from the designated car park. Other sections of the Anglesey Coast Path may involve uneven heathland terrain.

plan.arrival: Pick up a rental in Holyhead or arrive via rail, then proceed west to the South Stack cliffs for check-in at local coastal accommodation.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for surfaced visitor center lots; check rental agreements for restrictions on unpaved stone parking areas.
plan.goldenHour: South Stack cliffs offer a western-facing aspect for sunset, though seasonal fog can obscure the Irish Sea horizon.
